description: For each Cursor key this project can use, show spend-down mode (ADR 0028): whether it is on, when the credits expire, the window state (off | not_started | active | expired | key_unusable), fixes started today out of the daily limit, the apps the key pays for that this project can see (each with its stop-loss state: paused when, over its spend-down runs of the last 14 days with 20+ samples, the 95% Wilson bound puts its Opus merge rate under 20%, hold rate over 35% or no-PR share over 50%; a paused app still gets 1 probe fix a day), a count of its other apps, the last 7 days' scoreboard (key-wide totals; per app × model × day rows for visible apps: runs, PRs, no-PR verdicts, other failures, Opus merge / fix_first / hold, merged, latest review cost per PR, merge and mergeable yield), and what the last worker tick did. Returns { keys: [{ id, label, keyHint, scope, enabled, creditsExpireAt, model, dailyLimit, windowDays, state, startsAt, dispatchedToday, remainingToday, projects: [{ id, name, canResume, stopLoss }], otherApps, projectsNote, stopLossNote, scoreboard: { days, since, totals, rows } | null, scoreboardNote, lastRunAt, lastSummary }], reviewFollowups: { days, dispatched, finished, pushed, noChange, verdictsAfter: { merge, fix_first, hold }, awaitingReview, conversionRate, skipped, apps } | null } — reviewFollowups (ADR 0032) is what sending fix_first PRs back to an agent with the Opus findings produced in the last 7 days, over the apps you can access. Read-only. Use to see whether expiring Cursor credits are being used and what they produce; use set_byok_spend_down to change it.
name: get_spend_down_status
title: Spend-down status of Cursor keys
